ABOUT 7 STAR RANCH

7 Star Ranch is owned and operated by Marcial & Briana Gomez. The Ranch is based in Naples, Florida and offers grassfed beef, pastured pork, chicken, eggs, raw dairy products, and a home-made goodies such as baked items and seasonal jams.

Shop Now
OUR FARM PRODUCTS

At 7 Star Ranch, we take pride in providing high-quality farm products. Our commitment to natural and sustainable farming practices ensures that you receive the best quality products, directly from our farm to your table.

How it Works

7 Star Ranch is not open to the public for visitors and we currently do not operate a storefront. We offer multiple pickup locations from which you may meet us to get the items you order. Delivery is available on orders more than $200, please contact us to arrange this.

What Happens if I miss my pickup?

We understand that sometimes plans change and things get forgotten. If you miss your pickup, please reach out to us as soon as possible. Please do not attend another pickup and take items without first speaking to us. Missed pickups are subject to a $15 restocking fee.

What Happens if I forget my Milk Jars?

Our Raw Milk program runs on jar exchanges, because we package in glass. It is vital that you remember to bring your jars to pickups for exchange. If you forget your jars, you can pay a $5 deposit per jar or pay the restocking fee and reschedule pickup for another time when you have your jars. This policy will be strictly enforced not because of the cost of the jars, but because of the time it takes us to drive from store to store searching for jars. This program isn't a good fit for all customers: if you repeatedly forget your jars, we will be unable to continue selling milk to you.

Do you offer any other pickup locations?

We offer pickup in Davie, FL, and the Marathon, FL by appointment. Please call or text us to make arrangements for these pickup locations.

ABOUT 7 STAR RANCH

7 Star Ranch is excited to offer fresh products grown on the farm right here in Naples FL. We are a small, family owned and operated farm. We raise chickens, pigs, beef, and dairy cattle.  At 7 Star Ranch, we are passionate about delivering superior quality fresh products to our customers. Our farm is committed to upholding the highest standards of quality in everything we do. We prioritize the well-being of our animals and the environment, using renewable energy sources and natural farming practices whenever possible. Place your order today to experience the difference of farm-fresh goodness straight from 7 Star Ranch.

Contact Us
Natural -  Local  -  Fresh

7 Star Ranch takes pride in offering naturally raised products. Our commitment to ethical and sustainable farming practices sets us apart, allowing us to provide our customers with wholesome and nutritious options. Whether you're looking for raw milk, grassfed beef, fresh eggs, or free-range chicken, you can trust 7 Star Ranch to deliver products of the highest quality. Explore our range of farm-fresh goodness and elevate your culinary experience with our premium offerings.

What breed are the chickens?

They are a Cornish cross chicken, bred specifically as a meat bird.

What are the chickens fed?

The chickens are fed a non-GMO meat bird-specific diet, and allowed to free range in the safety of their chicken tractor.  They also receive fresh fruits and veggies from our garden when available.
